about: The bots ideas work, round 3: theme G's lines of the H builder (the update buzz at Rellekka: going, there, leaving; the rock crabs; the lighthouse's causeway and its slips; chompy hunting, last and first to cut), in a late-2004 voice, the same shape and rules as lines2004.json: each group's tag says where and when it is true. Each set-piece group's tag carries the event 'buzz' (never noted on a bot, so the idle picker never says them out of turn), members true, and its kinds by moment (buzz-*, crabs-*, lighthouse-*, chompy-*); its lines are said only through port/BotPeriodPlan sayPeriodLine (kind 'setpiece': out of H7, counted in X2, in the place of the speaker's next unprompted line) or port/BotArcsSay sayArcLine with a budget mode. New thread topics' lines go to data/threads.json. Every line (a {slot} filled from the samples the H builder gives in test/chat-filter.test.mjs's G buzz block) through the 274 filter and charset (test/chat-filter.test.mjs covers every group of GROUPS_2004). (Round 3's tune, 2026-11-01: the talk-* groups (talk-crabs, talk-fremmy, talk-hftd) are the update's idle talk, said through port/BotPeriodTalk periodIdleLine in the place of the speaker's due idle line, kind 'idle' (in H7, a substitution); the same event 'buzz', so the idle picker never says them either, and no tag on them: word of them boosts no hearer. The KQ fixes, T-3: each quest's talk split by what the speaker has done, as its own answer to "did you do X" says (port/BotAnswers saysQuestDone, combat 45): talk-fremmy-done / talk-fremmy-todo, talk-hftd-done / talk-hftd-todo, and a group of lines either may say, its tag with both kinds.)
